note: [L] parametrizes K_j by its curvature jets in `Shell` and maps them to radial potentials by `gaugeJet`, instead of imposing the equation on the potential A_j. The ideal is stated as the kernel of `observable` and shown equal to the vanishing on all shell towers.

snippet.text: def equationIdeal (G : Gauge) (d : ℕ) := LinearMap.ker (observable G d)

proof_context.conclusion: `equationIdeal G d` is the kernel of `observable`, the labels of weight <= d that vanish under substitution of Maxwell-shell jets.

snippet.text:
theorem ideal_meaning {d : ℕ} {A : Labels.Label G d} : A ∈ equationIdeal G d ↔
    ∀ X : TaylorTower G, Labels.read (fun i => gaugeJet (X i)) A.val = 0 := by
  change reduceEq A.val = 0 ↔ _
  constructor
  · intro h X; rw [← jet_value X, h, map_zero]
  intro h; exact equalPol _ _ (by intro X; rw [jet_value, h,map_zero])

proof_context.conclusion: A label lies in `equationIdeal` iff `read (gaugeJet (X i)) A = 0` for every tower `X` of shell jets, i.e. iff it vanishes on the product of the shells.

snippet.text:
def onShell (F : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (j : ℕ) : Submodule ℝ (TwoJet F j) where
  carrier := {Q | Q ∈ formSpace j F ∧ ∀ b x, ∑ a : Axis, grad a (diagonal (Q a b)) x = 0}
  zero_mem' := by
    refine ⟨Submodule.zero_mem _, ?_⟩
    intro b z
    change ∑ a : Axis, fderiv ℝ (fun y : E4 => (0:F)) z (basis a) = _
    simp
  add_mem' := by
    rintro x y ⟨hx,h⟩ ⟨hy,H⟩
    refine ⟨Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy, ?_⟩
    intro b z
    have he (a : Axis) : grad a (diagonal ((x+y) a b)) z =
        grad a (diagonal (x a b)) z + grad a (diagonal (y a b)) z := by
      change fderiv ℝ (diagonal (x a b) + diagonal (y a b)) z _ = _
      rw [fderiv_add ((diag_smooth _ ∞).differentiable (by simp) _)
        ((diag_smooth _ ∞).differentiable (by simp) _)]; rfl
    simp_rw [he, Finset.sum_add_distrib, h,H,add_zero]
  smul_mem' := by
    rintro t x ⟨hx,h⟩
    refine ⟨Submodule.smul_mem _ t hx, ?_⟩
    intro b z
    have he (a : Axis) : grad a (diagonal ((t • x) a b)) z = t • grad a (diagonal (x a b)) z := by
      change fderiv ℝ (t • diagonal (x a b)) z _ = _
      rw [fderiv_const_smul ((diag_smooth _ ∞).differentiable (by simp) _)]; rfl
    simp_rw [he, ← Finset.smul_sum, h, smul_zero]

proof_context.conclusion: `onShell` is the space of closed two-forms `Q` with `sum_a grad a (Q a b) = 0` for every `b`, the Maxwell equation, from which `gaugeJet` recovers the radial potential.
